Scm 310, Scm 320, Mgt360 these three are taken by Meshbaul Hassan Chowdhury sir (Mhcw).
At first the topics might seem a little bit confusing and the questions will be conceptual as well as from memories. But if you properly study and go through the books you will be able to ace it. Sir helps a lot. So, if you work hard you will get a good grade.
Scm 320 is also being taken by Dr. Zerin Tasnim (ZTM) ma'am.
She is a really helpful and kind person. If you are attentive in class most of the time that is enough. Her questions are standard so it is not really difficult.

MHCW sir is a nice person, but MGT-360 itself is a very hard course … maths are really really different and hard. To do well in MCQs make sure you are reading the book , for Short questions take notes in class , and for maths , do every and each math that sir will show you in the class . And make sure your report is not plagiarised and idea is authentic.
For SQM , sir keeps course contents pretty easy if you are from Science background. But be consistent.
As far I remember, ABq1 sir is really good at teaching. He makes sure you understand everything.
